independence_rule: T02-T14 use exactly two source-independent CPU/no-model implementations with distinct root algorithms, executables, and implementation identities. T14 additionally uses exactly two distinct predecessor-only cold-replay implementations and one independence receipt.
phase_rule: T01 is only the actual generic architecture-intake lifecycle evidence and has no PPC fixture, PPC TEST_RESULT, implementation, or sealer. T02-T12 are post-ratification and PRE_MODEL. T13 is the final PRE_MODEL_EXECUTION authority gate. T14 is PRE_SCIENTIFIC_CLAIM.
